          Help Me Choose

          Top RBC Cash Back Mastercard Questions

          When you make a purchase with your RBC Cash Back Preferred World Elite Mastercard, you earn cash back on a percentage of the purchase.

          You’ll earn 1.5% on the first $25,000 in all qualifying purchases and 1% thereafter1.

          There’s no limit to the maximum cash back you can earn with your RBC Cash Back Preferred World Elite Mastercard. All qualifying purchases (up to your available credit limit) contribute to your cash back earning3.

          To redeem your cash back, simply request a credit to your credit card account once your cash back balance hits $25 or more and we’ll issue the credit within 5 business days. Or, wait for it to be automatically credited to your account in January each year as long as your cash back balance exceeds $25. Your credit card account must be in good standing at the time the cash back is credited.
          You can easily check your cash back balance on your monthly statement, or check it anytime through RBC Online Banking.
          To learn more about Avion Rewards and how you can access the program, click here.
